title: Trading Jobs for a Day
transcript: I work at the front desk of a hotel, and last month our manager asked staff to spend a morning in another department. I joined the cleaning team, who showed me how they prepare a room for the next guest. I had no idea how long it took to change the beds and check all the lights. Now, if guests arrive early, I offer to store their bags and tell them honestly when their room will be ready. It makes the wait easier for everyone.

questions.prompt: What did the manager ask staff to do?
options: Attend a class about hotel management.
Try working in another department for a morning.
questions.answer: Try working in another department for a morning.
questions.explanation: 经理让员工用一个上午到其他部门体验工作。

options: How long preparing a room took.
How early the guests got up.
How often the hotel lost keys.
questions.answer: How long preparing a room took.
